name: Aroma of Affection
overview: Mali, a famed beauty whose natural fragrance captivates the elite becomes the obsession of Luang Inthrabhodi, a powerful warrior sworn to protect the kingdom. Determined to claim her as his wife despite rigid class divisions and public scorn, he defies convention—only to be trapped in an arranged marriage to a noblewoman. As desire collides with duty, the two lovers must confront the social barriers threatening to keep them apart.
